thread:
Asha (ops_lead): RCA posted for yesterday's throughput incident — link: https://confluence.redwood.company/rca/2581234567. TL;DR: incorrect fallback routing + autoscaler race on scale-down. Please read; owners + action items below.
Tom (eng-infra): reading now. is there a small patch we can backport to reduce blast radius?
Javier (eng-runtime): yes — core fix is in PR #4321, but it requires a config change for routing precedence. patch + config change should remove the window where requests get routed to exhausted pools.
Asha (ops_lead): action items from RCA summary: 1) backport PR #4321 and deploy to staging (owner: eng-infra/Tom) — target: 2026-04-02; 2) routing precedence change (+ tests) (owner: eng-runtime/Javier) — target: 2026-04-05; 3) add autoscaler safety gate to avoid scale-down during active drain (owner: eng-sre) — target: 2026-04-07; 4) customer-impact review + outbound comms (owner: product/Leah & cs/Maya) — draft by EOD 2026-04-01.
ops-bot: RCA doc https://confluence.redwood.company/rca/2581234567 published by Asha. Actions created: INF-789, RTE-102, SRE-456.
Leah (product): pinging @Maya — any customers we should prioritize for proactive outreach?
Maya (customer-success): yes — two customers on Dedicated saw increased tail latency. I've listed them in the RCA with contact owners. I'll draft a short note and share for review by tomorrow morning.
Tom (eng-infra): starting the backport now. I'll open a small rollback-safe deploy with feature flag. keeping it low-risk.
Javier (eng-runtime): I'll add a canary route policy and a smoke test that verifies fallback behaviour before full rollout.
Asha (ops_lead): scheduling a 30min checkpoint Thursday 11am PT to review progress + sign-off on comms — calendar invite: https://calendar.redwood.company/evt/2581234567-checkpoint. Please add any blockers to the thread.
Leah (product): will share the outbound comm draft in #customer-comms for feedback.
Tom (eng-infra): quick note — we observed the autoscaler logging showing scale-down at t=14s; adding a 60s stabilization window should prevent immediate rebalancing. PR will include metrics and a flag.
Maya (customer-success): added the customer names to the doc and flagged the highest-risk tenant for prioritized outreach.
Asha (ops_lead): thanks everyone. please react to the RCA with :eyes: when you've read and :white_check_mark: when your action is complete. we'll close the loop on Friday. :thumbsup:
